name: G026 frameset

editorial.verdict: One of the cheapest frames with T47, UDH, storage, and 50 mm clearance; best suited to a risk-tolerant custom builder.
caveats: Less independent verification and test disclosure

purchase_route: On 2026-09-24 the exact SPcycle official-store page listed US$998 regular / US$718 sale per piece and displayed “50 items available,” buy-now and add-to-cart controls. The page does not map price or visible availability to a selected size, color or finish. Its listed package includes frame, fork, handlebar, seatpost and small parts. Confirm the selected configuration, mainland shipping, tax, warranty and final checkout before paying.
